channel.title: Rust Development Updates
channel.description: AI-summarized daily Rust development updates from Facepunch source-control commits.

item.title: Today's Rust Updates — Sep 15
item.description:
70 development commits

✨ NEW — LAST 3 HRS

  • Adjusted animal population rates.
  • Fixed turtle spawning issue.
  • Fixed launch site loot room in NMS.
  • Added water treatment plant and sewer branch loot rooms.
  • Improved fence deployment: prevents sinking, better slope placement, up to 20° angle, no unwanted rotation.

Wildlife & Creatures

  • Adjusted animal population rates.
  • Fixed turtle spawning issue.
  • Improved sheep behavior: hostile when attacked, proper walking, attacking, and death.
  • Fixed beef spoil item assignment, correcting spoilage bugs.

Loot & Facilities

  • Fixed launch site loot room in NMS.
  • Added water treatment plant and sewer branch loot rooms.
  • Expanded hunting trophies to include cow, bull, and sheep variants with smaller prefabs for performance.

Building & Terrain

  • Improved fence deployment: prevents sinking, better slope placement, up to 20° angle, no unwanted rotation.
  • Added explosive setup to certain weapons.
  • Implemented 3D explosive crater definitions that respect blocking objects.

Interface & Controls

  • Fixed player count display glitch when switching game modes in the server browser.
  • Market terminal now shows "No Power" when unpowered, indicating shops are still browseable.
  • Added bind command to reset gamepad defaults and fixed binding reset issues when no mouse/keyboard present.

Server & Reporting

  • Fixed player bot reporting functionality.
  • Fixed server browser filter issue.

item.title: Yesterday's Rust Updates — Sep 14
item.description:
80 development commits

Server & UI

  • Fixed inaccurate server browser gamemode filter counts and prevented mixing of unrelated gamemodes.
  • Fixed various input binding issues, including gamepad key‑assign closure, key latching after input clear, and missing map close binding.

Animals, Resources & Mounting

  • Restored missing beef resource links for livestock.
  • Lamb and calf corpses no longer yield any resources when killed.
  • Attacking farm animals now marks you as hostile to safezones.
  • Adjusted critter population settings.
  • Fixed issues with multiple animals near vehicles and added support for mounting Gen2 AI via a new NPCMountable component.

Structures & Collision

  • Halved fence gate opening/closing speed for smoother operation.
  • Fixed fence collider issues, enabled fence demolition, and added blue highlight to demolishable fences.
  • Fixed hitbox collision detection errors.

Combat, Weapons & Cooking

  • Adjusted salvaged cleaver distance to correct melee reach.
  • Fixed raw beef missing its cooking reference and added new meat types to all oven prefabs.

UI & Visuals

  • Store images now correctly generate and display blurhash placeholders, preventing missing or broken backgrounds in the store UI.
  • Editor now reads textures as sRGB when possible, improving color accuracy of generated blurhash previews.

item.title: Rust Updates — 2 Days Ago — Sep 13
item.description:
10 development commits

Animals & Resources

  • Cows now drop beef instead of generic cow meat.

Weapons

  • Mini crossbow functionality restored after fix.

Gameplay & Balance

  • Sheep now correctly produce poop, restoring the fertilizer resource.

Bug Fixes

  • Resolved a manifest error caused by null bones in cow skeleton assets; the game now logs a warning instead of crashing.
